fields.Name: T100 - Message Actions On AI Message
fields.Description: Exercises MessageItemComponent footer controls (PinMessage, mj-conversation-message-rating, reaction buttons) on a rendered message — a distinct per-message interaction path from send/compose.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the Chat application and wait for the workspace. Select the conversation named 'Membership renewal questions' from the sidebar — it is seeded with a completed AI message for this test. If it is missing, pick any other conversation that already contains an AI reply, or as a last resort send a message and wait for one. On a completed AI message, confirm the per-message action affordances render: a pin (thumbtack) button, a thumbs up/down rating control, and reaction buttons. Click the pin button and confirm its pinned state toggles (e.g. it highlights and/or a pinned-messages chip appears in the header). Seeing the message action controls render and the pin toggle respond is success. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: An existing/received AI message shows per-message controls (pin/thumbtack, thumbs rating, reactions)
Clicking the pin button toggles its state (highlight and/or a pinned indicator/chip in the header)
The controls are interactive without breaking the message thread layout
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
